description: E26 line-by-line accounting of the archived unierp-app-healthcare repository. Every archived source file is disposed as PORTED (logic carried forward), REWRITTEN (re-expressed against the public extension API), or DROPPED (with a reason). Enforced by scripts/check-e26-port.mjs.

entries.reason: Prisma models re-expressed as declared extension schema entities (provisioned as ext_healthcare_<entity> with tenant_id+RLS); money fields declared decimal.
Prisma CLI config; the extension has no Prisma data layer.
Bundle/signing tooling superseded by the platform's signed-bundle pipeline; the repo builds with tsc and the platform signs at install.
One-off marketplace install-bundle generator; install is now a platform operation over the declared manifest (src/manifest.ts).
Manifest shape now comes from the published ExtensionManifestV1 type; the local duplicate is removed.
NestJS bootstrap; the platform is the host for extensions.
NestJS controller endpoints re-expressed as customRoutes handlers.
Domain logic carried forward as pure functions over in-memory record sets.
Direct core data access; extensions receive their declared record sets from the platform.
Core event fan-out was monolith infrastructure; extension events are a manifest scope, not a local HTTP endpoint.
Platform owns liveness/health endpoints.
NestJS controller endpoints re-expressed as customRoutes handlers.
Eligibility, claim scrub, drug interactions, CDS, quality measures, FHIR projections carried forward as pure functions.
NestJS CRUD controller endpoints re-expressed as customRoutes handlers.
CRUD domain logic carried forward as pure functions over in-memory record sets.
NestJS HTTP bootstrap; the platform loads extension factories.
Pagination helpers carried forward unchanged.
Prisma client; extensions have no direct DB handle.
Reference datasets (payers, drug interactions, ICD-10, CPT, LOINC, vaccines) carried forward unchanged.
Authorization is enforced by the platform via manifest scope grants; the extension cannot self-authorize.
Tenant identity is provided by the platform context (ExtensionContext.tenantId).
Tenant-context token handling owned by the platform sandbox boundary.
